# Requirements Quality Checklist: Task Management

**Purpose**: Author self-review of spec.md's requirement completeness, clarity, and consistency before running `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-08-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the maximum task title length a testable, numeric requirement, or is its deferral to implementation an explicit, deliberate choice rather than an oversight? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what happens if the backing database is unreachable when a user attempts to create, edit, toggle, or delete a task? [Gap, Completeness]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement covering the case where a user attempts to edit or delete a task that no longer exists (e.g., already deleted from another view)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for whether internal whitespace within a title (not just leading/trailing) is normalized before storage? [Gap, Completeness]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the starting point for the "under 10 seconds" bound in SC-001 defined (e.g., from app open, from typing start, or from submit)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "immediately" in FR-011 quantified with a bound, or left as a purely qualitative term? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the specific form of user feedback for a rejected empty-title submission specified (e.g., inline message vs. blocked submit vs. alert), or left fully open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the delete-confirmation interaction (FR-009) specified precisely enough to distinguish "confirm" from "cancel" outcomes, independent of any particular UI widget? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Does the Assumptions statement that "no sorting beyond status filtering is needed" conflict with FR-003's requirement to order tasks by creation time (newest-first)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions vs §FR-003] — Resolved: Assumptions now names the fixed newest-first order (FR-003) as the baseline and scopes the exclusion to user-selectable sort options only.
- [ ] CHK010 Is the "Pending"/"Completed" terminology used consistently across User Scenarios, Functional Requirements, and Key Entities, with no alternate synonyms (e.g., "done", "active") introduced? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the two independent update operations (title edit, status toggle) in FR-005/FR-007 consistent with the Key Entities statement that title and status are independent attributes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, §Key Entities]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can "at a glance" in SC-002 be objectively verified, or is it a subjective, non-measurable claim? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is SC-004's "without confusion about what happened after each action" measurable/verifiable, or does it need a concrete, observable proxy (e.g., a specific confirmation signal per action)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Does every acceptance scenario under User Story 1–5 have a corresponding, uniquely identifiable functional requirement it verifies? [Traceability]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Does the spec define expected behavior when a task's status changes such that it no longer matches the currently active filter (e.g., marking a task pending while the "Completed" filter is active)? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for the very first use of the application, when no tasks exist under any filter, beyond the general empty-state note in Edge Cases? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for creating many tasks in quick succession (e.g., does display order/behavior remain well-defined under rapid creation)? [Gap, Coverage]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are boundary requirements defined for a title at exactly the maximum allowed length vs. one character over? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec address whether a task can be created, edited, or deleted while another such operation on the same task is still in flight? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK020 Is the no-op case (editing a title to its current, unchanged value) requirement in Edge Cases consistent with FR-006's rejection rule for empty/whitespace titles? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases vs §FR-006] — Resolved: FR-006 and Edge Cases now both state explicitly that resubmitting the current non-empty title succeeds as a normal update and is not treated as an empty/whitespace rejection.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Are accessibility requirements (e.g., keyboard operability of the filter control and delete confirmation) defined anywhere in the spec, or explicitly declared out of scope? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK022 Are there any requirements bounding acceptable response latency for create/edit/toggle/delete actions beyond the qualitative "immediately" in FR-011? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the spec state a requirement or assumption for concurrent use (e.g., two browser tabs open to the same task list), or is single-session use an implicit, unstated assumption? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the Assumptions claim that the task list "will stay small enough" validated against any stated upper bound, or is it an unverified assertion? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption that the filter selection need not persist across restarts consistent with SC-004's expectation of an uninterrupted, non-confusing user session? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions vs §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Are all explicit scope exclusions (no auth, no due dates/priorities/categories, no undo/trash) consolidated in one place, or split across Assumptions and Functional Requirements in a way that risks future drift? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions vs §FR-013]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Since duplicate task titles are explicitly permitted (Clarifications), does the spec clarify how a user is expected to distinguish between two identically-titled tasks when choosing which one to edit, complete, or delete? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications vs §Key Entities]

## Notes

- Generated per user selection: focus = requirements completeness/clarity; audience = author self-review before `/speckit-tasks`; depth = standard.
- CHK009 and CHK020 flagged genuine internal inconsistencies introduced when clarifications were integrated; both have been resolved directly in spec.md (see inline notes above).
- Items are questions about the requirements' quality, not tests of the eventual implementation. Check items off once spec.md has been reviewed and, where needed, updated to resolve the gap/ambiguity/conflict.
